## Notes

- **Orders:** name `pnpm --filter <pkg> run typecheck` for every touched package (the `dispatch-gates --commands` list omits it), and put every file a behaviour change can turn red on the surface up front (a card thread refuses mid-round seat grants).
- **Write path:** the relay (`post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`). ⛔ No GitHub MCP writes.
- **Publication:** objectstack. A merge to `main` publishes nothing; the release is the Version Packages PR, which a person merges. ⛔ Release PRs are never touched.
